title: 3 Claude Code commands most people never use: /compact to sh

storyPlan.premise: 3 Claude Code commands most people never use: /compact to shrink a long session without losing the thread, /rewind to undo the last changes, and plan mode (Shift+Tab) to see the plan before any file is touched. Show each one working.

plan.visualBrief: Three file cards break and glow orange, /rewind is typed in the terminal below, and an orange U-turn arrow sweeps over them as they snap back clean with checks.

scenes.vo: Claude Code just broke three files? One command undoes it.

plan.visualBrief: The terminal grows into a big Claude Code window while three empty numbered slots drop in above it and a big orange counter clicks 1, 2, 3.

scenes.vo: It's one of three Claude Code commands most people never use.

plan.visualBrief: Slot 1 fills with /rewind, the command is typed, three edit lines roll back one by one, and the three broken files below light up and snap back clean.

scenes.vo: First, slash rewind. Type it, and Claude Code undoes its last changes. Those three broken files? Clean again.

plan.visualBrief: Slot 2 fills with /compact; a tall scrolling chat history squeezes into a short block inside the dashed outline of its old size, while an orange thread line from start to finish stays unbroken.

scenes.vo: Second, slash compact. When a session gets long and heavy, it shrinks it down, without losing the thread of what you're building.

plan.visualBrief: Slot 3 fills with Plan mode, big Shift and Tab keys press down, a numbered plan unfolds in the terminal, and the three files beside it lock with orange padlocks.

scenes.vo: Third, plan mode. Press Shift Tab, and Claude shows you its plan first. Not a single file is touched until you're happy with it.

plan.visualBrief: The three filled command slots shrink into a column on the left, a comment bubble pops up beside them, then a big Follow button lights orange and pulses.

scenes.vo: Drop a comment if you want more Claude Code tips like these, and follow so you don't miss the next one.
